CRITICAL fixed: EUR.1 validity was self-contradictory (4-10 months / 10-month rejection bullet). Israel applies 2012 PEM => EUR.1 valid 4 months from issue. The 10-month figure is the revised-PEM value Israel has not adopted; now labeled not-applicable-to-Israel. Source: Access2Markets PEM page 'The proof of origin is valid for a period of 4 months from the date of issue.'

MAJOR fixed: revised PEM date was wrong (said 'fully applies from January 1, 2026'). EU sources: revised PEM entered into force 1 January 2025; 2025 a transition year (2012 + 2023 rules in parallel through 31 Dec 2025); only revised rules apply from 1 Jan 2026 between ratifying parties. Israel stays on 2012. Mirrored in SKILL.md gotcha + SKILL_HE.md + pem-2026-rules.md.

JUDGE fixed: re-cited eur1-6000-threshold to Access2Markets PEM page ('any exporter, if the total value of the products does not exceed EUR 6,000.') and cifta-2019-4-years to CBSA D11-4-2 (literal in-force date + 'four years after the date on which it is signed') plus Canada Gazette SI/TR-77 corroboration. Both snippets WebFetch-verified literal.

CRITICAL fixed: generate_invoice.py added freight+insurance into the invoice total under EVERY Incoterm. Verified live: FOB goods 100.00 printed total 500.00 EUR. Now excluded for EXW/FCA/FAS/FOB and printed as buyer's-account memo lines.
CRITICAL fixed: line totals did not reconcile with printed unit prices (33.333x3 rendered as '33.33 x 3 = 100.00'). Unit is now quantized BEFORE multiplying.

CRITICAL fixed: script hard-coded 'ISRAEL' as country of origin while sample_order.json carried a country_of_origin key that was silently ignored. A re-export would have printed a false origin statement on a customs document. Script now honours the field.

CRITICAL fixed: EUR-MED was documented as retired with 'never request one'. That is true only under the REVISED PEM rules; Israel is on the 2012 rules where the EU states EUR.1 or EUR-MED are issued by the exporting country's customs. Corroborated by Turkey having to actively HALT EUR-MED issuance for Israel in Feb 2026.

CRITICAL fixed: references/eur1-application-guide.md still listed Mercosur as a EUR.1 route after the Mercosur fix landed in the two SKILL files and origin-declaration-template.md. Mercosur is not a PEM party and has its own certificate. Lesson: when correcting a destination, grep EVERY file for it, references included.

MAJOR fixed: the Green Form / Form A retirement date was attached to the wrong trade direction. 10 January 2018 is US-to-Israel. For Israel-to-US, CBP eliminated Form A on 20 May 1994 and replaced it with an importer affidavit on request; CBP says the 2017 amendment 'represents no change in the ILFTA requirements for importations into the United States'.

MAJOR fixed: 'the tax point for goods is delivery' was overstated. Section 22(b) puts dealers under 2 million NIS turnover on a CASH basis. A small exporter following the flat statement would misdate the whole reporting period.
MAJOR fixed: --packing-list flag was undocumented and the documented run command produced no packing list at all.
MAJOR fixed: SKILL_HE.md listed seller.vat_id as optional while SKILL.md and the script required it; a Hebrew-reading user would build JSON per the documented contract and get exit code 1.

MAJOR fixed: evidence.json held BOTH the old Korea date (1 Jan 2023) and the new one (1 Dec 2022). Adding a corrected claim without removing the superseded one makes the evidence file self-refuting. Same failure mode as the severance skill earlier in this batch.

MAJOR fixed: the 6,000 EUR ceiling was described as applying to 'the total invoice value'. PEM wording is 'the total value of the products', i.e. the goods, not the grand total with freight stacked on. Script correctly tests the goods subtotal; prose now matches.
Korea KIFTA corrected to 1 December 2022 (was 1 January 2023).
Turkey removed from the routine EUR.1 row: May 2024 embargo still in force, tightened Feb 2026.

Added: non-preferential chamber-of-commerce certificate of origin (was entirely absent), dated EU-preference status note, exchange-rate/tax-point guidance, allocation-number thresholds (10,000 NIS Jan 2026 / 5,000 NIS Jun 2026), CIFTA CAD 3,300 low-value exemption + Form E669.

TOOLING LESSON: verify-evidence.py --check-sources matches against RAW HTML, so a snippet whose words span tags or contain entities ( , ", gershayim vs ASCII quote) fails even when the text is plainly visible on the page. Extract snippets from raw HTML, never from WebFetch output, which paraphrases.

PROCESS LESSON: both panel subagents idled without returning verdicts. Self-review is not a substitute for the independent-judge property. A fresh synchronous judge run found 8 defects that the self-review had missed, including three CRITICALs. Always re-spawn rather than treat agent silence as a pass.
